purpose: Execute the actual fixed six-tape157-state signed-pair controller against independent integer comparison when both cross-sums fit, and independent modular cross-sum comparison otherwise.8744 total cases,5780 fitting cases,zero failures. Includes empty/small exhaustive words, one-bit padding, overflow, negative values,cancellation and larger words. Check halt/result, all four exact sources, both physically cleared/prepared scratch tapes and all six distinct absolute heads. Universal native correctness/cost and fit conditions are separately kernel checked.
source:
import TransposeFollowup.SignedPairMachine
open TransposeFollowup FixedTapeCompiler
open SignedPair CopyMachine

def bits (m a : Nat) : List Bool := (List.range m).map a.testBit

def heads : Port → Int
  | .a => 17 | .b => -11 | .c => 5 | .d => -23 | .left => 31 | .right => -43

def order (a b : Int) : BinaryCompare.Result :=
  if a < b then .less else if a > b then .greater else .equal

def checkCase (m a b c d : Nat) : Bool := Id.run do
  let wa := bits m a
  let wb := bits m b
  let wc := bits m c
  let wd := bits m d
  let final := NativeZipper.run program (23*m+37)
    (zipperCfg (.add false (.scan false false)) (ready wa wb wc wd) heads)
  let fits := a+d < 2^m && c+b < 2^m
  let expected := if fits then order ((a:Int)-b) ((c:Int)-d)
    else order (((a+d)%2^m : Nat):Int) (((c+b)%2^m : Nat):Int)
  let clean := fun p => decide ((final.core.tapes p).left = [.start]) &&
    (final.core.tapes p).right.all (fun s => decide (s = .blank))
  return decide (final.core.pc = .done expected) &&
    decide (final.core.tapes .a = BinaryCarry.marked wa) &&
    decide (final.core.tapes .b = BinaryCarry.marked wb) &&
    decide (final.core.tapes .c = BinaryCarry.marked wc) &&
    decide (final.core.tapes .d = BinaryCarry.marked wd) && clean .left && clean .right &&
    [Port.a,.b,.c,.d,.left,.right].all (fun p => decide (final.pos p = heads p))

def allChecks : Nat × Nat × Nat := Id.run do
  let mut count := 0
  let mut signed := 0
  let mut failed := 0
  for k in List.range 4 do
    for a in List.range (2^k) do
      for b in List.range (2^k) do
        for c in List.range (2^k) do
          for d in List.range (2^k) do
            for m in [k,k+1] do
              count := count + 1
              if a+d < 2^m && c+b < 2^m then signed := signed + 1
              if !(checkCase m a b c d) then failed := failed + 1
  for t in [(10,1000,997,1001,998),(10,1,1000,0,999),(10,1000,1,999,0),
      (12,1000,997,1001,998),(12,0,4095,0,4094),(16,1,60000,3,60002)] do
    count := count + 1
    if t.2.1+t.2.2.2.2 < 2^t.1 && t.2.2.2.1+t.2.2.1 < 2^t.1 then signed := signed+1
    if !(checkCase t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2.1 t.2.2.2.1 t.2.2.2.2) then failed := failed+1
  return (count, signed, failed)
#eval allChecks
